---
title: rendering to one or both formats
---

To render to both the `html`- and `pdf`-format extensions `quarto-cheatsheet-html` and `quarto-cheatsheet-v2-pdf`, simply issue

```bash
quarto render <doc.qmd>
```

To render to only a single format, issue

```bash
quarto render <doc.qmd> --to quarto-cheatsheet-v2-html
quarto render <doc.qmd> --to quarto-cheatsheet-pdf
```
